title: Metamorphosis
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An explicit adult (hentai) manga. Shy student Saki Yoshida changes her looks to fit in at high school, but an older man drugs, assaults and manipulates her. What follows is a downward spiral of drug addiction, prostitution, repeated sexual abuse (including by her father), abortions and a miscarriage, ending in her death from a heroin overdose.
life_message: None is offered; the author says he set out to show a miserable heroine's decline, and the story reads as an unrelieved tragedy of exploitation.
